description: Select a real build-adapter-backed verifier for a workspace. Uses the locked BuildAdapterRegistry to detect the build system (Python/Rust/Go/Node/Maven/Gradle) and derives the canonical verifier argv (e.g. `pytest`, `cargo test`, `go test`). The selected command is intended to be invoked through `intake.hardened_runner.run` — this lock records the command but NEVER executes it.
purpose: Rung 4 of the real-model + build-adapter-verifier campaign (subordinate to Codex audit repair).

subordinate_to.note: This campaign does NOT claim full-suite clean until the Codex audit repair lands.
